summary: Address code smell: shotgun surgery cycle_telemetry in cycle skip conditions

delivery.outcome: Rename the generic telemetry-dict parameter 'cycle_telemetry' to stage-accurate names in each of the seven helper functions of src/koru/autonomy/cycle/cycle_skip_conditions.py that mutate it: diagnostics_skip_telemetry (_diagnostics_fail_skip_result), llm_ready_promotion_telemetry (_autopromote_waiting_ticket_llm_ready), new_ticket_clear_telemetry (_clear_manual_send_for_new_ticket), message_sent_clear_telemetry (_clear_manual_send_for_message_sent), alt_retry_telemetry (_allow_manual_send_alt_retry), manual_send_decision_telemetry (_manual_send_required_decision), stuck_status_telemetry (_handle_stuck_status_skip_candidate). The code2llm shotgun-surgery detector groups mutations by (file, variable) and fires at >= 5 scopes; the group drops from 8 scopes to 1. The entry point _check_autopilot_skip_conditions and the two pure pass-through helpers keep 'cycle_telemetry' because there it genuinely names the cycle-wide dict and produces no extra mutation group. Pure rename of parameters and their keyword call sites inside the module; no behavior change.
nonGoals: No behavior, telemetry-key, decision or interface change
No restructuring into a telemetry recorder class or central writer (each stage writes disjoint keys for its own decision; the shared generic name was the defect, not a missing abstraction)
No rename of the externally keyword-called parameter of _check_autopilot_skip_conditions or of cycle_telemetry parameters in other modules

architecture.decision: Stage-accurate parameter renames only, inside one module. Every mutating helper names the telemetry view of the decision stage it records; the umbrella name cycle_telemetry remains only at the gate entry and in the pure pass-throughs (_manual_send_required_skip_result, _resolve_manual_send_follow_up), which produce no mutation records. Verified with the code2llm shotgun-surgery detector: baseline groups cycle_telemetry mutations in 8 scopes in the file (>= 5 threshold fires), after the rename the largest group in the file is 1 scope and no new (file, variable) group reaches the threshold.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; the parameters are named cycle_telemetry again and the smell report returns.

commands: python3 -c "<standalone DFGExtractor + SmellDetector._detect_shotgun_surgery on cycle_skip_conditions.py, original vs renamed>"
validation.evidence: Two-level verification on a plain /tmp copy of the tree. (1) Deterministic ground truth: the installed code2llm DFGExtractor plus the real SmellDetector._detect_shotgun_surgery run standalone on the single file reports 'Shotgun Surgery: cycle_telemetry' for the original content (8 mutating scopes, exactly matching the ticket) and nothing for the renamed content, with mutation count unchanged (113) and no new shotgun entry; the separate pre-existing 'Shotgun Surgery: ticket_id' finding is untouched by design. (2) End-to-end CLI cross-check with the ticket-generating invocation: original content fires both cycle_skip_conditions shotgun entries (2/2 runs), renamed content fires neither (1/1 run). Note: the CLI pipeline itself is nondeterministic for mutation-driven findings of this file (a control run on unchanged original content spontaneously dropped them once), which is why the standalone detector run is the authoritative evidence.

commands: python -m pytest tests/test_autonomous.py -q -k 'submit_unverified or idle_streak or stuck_waiting_input or llm_ready'
validation.evidence: All listed suites pass unchanged (pure rename; the renamed scopes are executed by existing tests asserting the same telemetry keys) and ruff reports zero errors on the touched file.
GOV-PASS 0 errors 0 warnings from the ticket worktree.
